parameters.content:
## 1. Load the client
A parent workflow passes a client ID. The matching row gives the website, industry and every competitor column, which are folded into one long research prompt.

## 2. Run the research in a browser
Airtop opens Genspark with a saved profile, dismisses the intro popup, types the prompt and waits for the deep research to finish before scraping the answer.

## 3. Save the report
An AI step pulls the report link out of the scraped page, saves it to your sheet, then closes the browser session so you are not billed for idle time.

# Competitor negative review research with Genspark and Airtop

Takes a client ID, looks up that client's website and competitors in a Google Sheet, then drives Genspark in a cloud browser to research what customers complain about most in those competitors' reviews. The finished report link is saved back to your sheet. Built as a sub-workflow, so it can be triggered per client from a parent workflow.

### How it works
1. A parent workflow calls this one with a client ID.
2. The client row is looked up in your sheet, and a Code node collects the website, industry and every column starting with Competitor.
3. Those details are folded into one long analyst prompt asking for negative review patterns, positioning gaps and recommended actions.
4. Airtop opens Genspark in a cloud browser using a saved profile, closes the intro popup, types the prompt and submits it.
5. Genspark deep research takes a while, so the workflow waits before scraping the finished answer off the page.
6. An AI step pulls the report link out of the scraped text and appends it to your output sheet.
7. The browser session is closed so you are not billed for idle time.

### Setup
1. Add your Airtop and OpenAI API keys, and connect your Google Sheets account.
2. Replace YOUR_CLIENT_SHEET_ID with the sheet holding your clients. It needs Client ID, Website URL, Client Industry and one or more Competitor columns.
3. Replace YOUR_OUTPUT_SHEET_ID with the sheet that should collect the report links.
4. In Airtop create a browser profile, log into Genspark inside it once, and put that profile name in Start browser session.

### Customization
Edit the prompt in Build the research prompt to research pricing, features or anything else instead of reviews.
